1.mascotDialogue: Two ends this time, not one — front for leaving, back for joining. Confuse them even once, and you have quietly built a stack instead.

2.mascotDialogue: That `% MAX` on both front and rear — this is what allows the array to wrap around gracefully, instead of shifting everyone forward each time someone leaves.

3.mascotDialogue: FRONT and REAR — two separate markers now. Watch them stay exactly two apart, no matter how much you enqueue or dequeue.

4.mascotDialogue: An empty queue is not 'nothing to see' — it is a specific, checkable state. If your dequeue does not check for it, it will hand you garbage, calmly, and call it a real value. Maa... ganbatte ne.
